title.narrative: Town Electrification Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The proposed investment program will improve power supply in provincial urban centers through replacement of high-cost diesel power generation with sustainable renewable energy power generation. The investment program will include (i) construction of about six run-of-river hydropower plants to supply provincial centers, (ii) construction of transmission systems to connect provincial centers, and (iii) capacity building within the power utility and communities. Project preparatory technical assistance (TA) was used in project preparation.

title.narrative: 22 Jan 2016 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/new-zealand-expands-funding-cleaner-more-reliable-power-png
Grant 0469: 95% of contracts awarded and 95% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 2713: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 2714: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: 1. Kimbe - Bialla Transmission line completed and commissioned in December 2017.
2. Divune Hydropower plant contract was signed in August 2016 and implementation is ongoing.
3. Supply of equipment for Ramazon and Divune transmission line was completed in August 2015.
4. Ru Creek hydropower rehabilitation contract was signed on 22 June 2018 and implementation is ongoing.
5. Lake Hargy hydropower rehabilitation contract was signed on 28 May 2018 and implementation is ongoing.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41504/41504-024-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Apr 2015: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41504-026-iee-01.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Aug 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41504-023-rp-05.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jul 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41504/41504-023-smr-en_7.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1) Six renewable energy power plants put into operation by PPL:
i) Divune Hydropower plant contract was signed in August 2016 and implementation is ongoing.
ii) Ru Creek hydropower rehabilitation contract was signed on 22 June 2018 and implementation is ongoing.
iii) Lake Hargy hydropower rehabilitation contract was signed on 28 May 2018 and implementation is ongoing.
2) Transmission lines constructed and operated by PPL:
i) Kimbe-Bialla Transmission line completed and commissioned in December 2017. 1469 poles erected (100%) and 142.8km stringing completed (100%). Bialla substation completed and transformers energized with Mai substation also completed.
ii) Supply of equipment for Ramazon and Divune transmission line was completed in August 2015. Installation and construction of transmission line is ongoing and is under the Government's funding.
3) Capacity building undertaken for implement agency and project beneficiaries:
i) Two procurement trainings were conducted for PPL staff in 2016 and 2017. Capacity Development Training was conducted in October 2016 and ADB Safeguards training also conducted for PPL staff in 2016.
ii) Power safety awareness was conducted in March 2017 for communities who will be connected to the Divune and Ramazon Hydro power transmission line. A financial literacy training was also conducted for these communities which included budgeting and savings.
4. The PMU renders efficient project management services:
The PMU is fully established and is operational.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/41504-023/main#project-tenders
